# Well Adjusted Chiropractic

> Chiropractic clinics in Colorado (Erie, Loveland, Greeley, Fort Collins) and Texas (Arlington),
> offering chiropractic adjustments, spinal decompression, massage therapy, dual shockwave therapy,
> custom foot orthotics, sports physicals and workplace wellness.

## Locations

- [Chiropractor Erie, CO](https://staywelladjusted.com/chiropractor-erie-co): 680 Mitchell Way Unit 160, Erie, CO 80516 — (970) 670-3607
- [Chiropractor Loveland, CO](https://staywelladjusted.com/chiropractor-loveland-co): 3850 N Grant Ave STE 100, Loveland, CO 80538 — (970) 427-2543
- [Chiropractor Greeley, CO](https://staywelladjusted.com/chiropractor-greeley-co): 6200 W 9th St #2A, Greeley, CO 80634 — (970) 888-7097
- [Chiropractor Fort Collins, CO](https://staywelladjusted.com/chiropractor-fort-collins-co): 1075 W Horsetooth Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80526 — (970) 714-2207
- [Chiropractor Arlington, TX](https://staywelladjusted.com/chiropractor-arlington-tx): 5717 SW Green Oaks Blvd, Arlington, TX 76017 — (682) 277-1966
